listing.title: Internship Domains
listing.heading: Internship Domains
listing.description: Explore internship opportunities for college students in India across web development, mobile applications and digital marketing. Other IT-related domains may be available, subject to your interests, existing knowledge and programme eligibility.

services.title: Web Development
services.summary: Explore a web development internship for students through practical activities and projects in website and web application development. Beginners can enquire about suitable starting options.
services.overview: Explore a web development internship for students through practical activities and projects in website and web application development. Beginners can enquire about suitable starting options. This internship training programme combines structured learning with opportunities to develop practical skills.
services.approach: Mentor-guided internship training helps students work through learning activities, clarify doubts and apply concepts in practical assignments. Project-based internship training gives students opportunities to apply concepts through assignments and practical projects that strengthen their skills.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the Radhika SkillForge internship programme?
faqs.answer: Internship opportunities are open to B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., B.Tech. and M.Sc. students, as well as other graduation and postgraduate students. Engineering, computer science, arts, science, commerce, biology and mathematics students can explore domains suited to their interests, current knowledge and programme eligibility.

faqs.question: Is this internship suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Students with no prior experience can explore beginner-friendly internship options suited to their interests and current knowledge. Eligibility and starting requirements vary by domain.

faqs.question: Will students receive an internship completion certificate?
faqs.answer: Students seeking an internship with certificate may receive an internship completion certificate after successfully meeting the applicable programme requirements.

faqs.question: Is academic internship support available?
faqs.answer: Academic internship support for college students may be available, subject to programme conditions and their institution’s requirements. Check that the selected programme meets your college’s requirements before applying.
